body.name: foldwise random-class replacement handle
body.construction: Condition on one training complement at a time. For \(u\in\{0,1,2\}\), use the classes \(\mathcal F_{\ell,u}\) to obtain conditional-mean bounds of order \(C_{\mathrm{sm}}r_{m,n}r_{e,n}\), conditional \(L^2(P)\) envelope bounds of order \(C_{\mathrm{sm}}(r_{m,n}+r_{e,n})\), and fixed-dimensional polynomial entropy. Combine these bounds with the explicitly defined path plug-in radius \(\upsilon_n\) to target \(\delta_n\le C_{\mathrm{sm}}\{r_{m,n}+r_{e,n}+r_{m,n}r_{e,n}+\upsilon_n\}+o_{\mathbb P}(1)\); use empirical curvature for \(\Lambda_n=O_{\mathbb P}(1)\), apply a conditional Gaussian maximal inequality to the multiplier difference, and sum the fixed number \(L\) of fold bounds without asserting independence across folds.
